explanation: The theorem says that the map induced by the identity ring hom on the library's own `KTheory.ProjectiveClass` (a K₀-style group of finitely generated projective modules, defined in ProjectiveModules/KTheory/K0.lean) is the identity. Its content lies entirely in the library's own definitions: `ProjectiveClass`, `map`, `addHom_ext` and `ModuleCat.RightExtension.idLinearEquiv`. I grepped Mathlib for `ProjectiveClass` and `FiniteProjective`. The only hit was Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Contraction.lean, and I did not open it. Since Mathlib has no K₀ group of projective modules for this to duplicate, that file presumably doesn't contain one. So I found no matching Mathlib declaration.
